events.text: Three Deep Space Network sites (California, Spain, Australia) take turns as Earth spins.
Radio and laser travel at light speed. One way to the Moon takes 1.28 s on average, so a chat has a 2.6 s pause.
Link up with Madrid. Sending at 8 Mbps.
Link up with Goldstone. Sending at 8 Mbps.
Link up with Canberra. Sending at 8 Mbps.
Behind the Moon: no contact for 41 minutes, like Artemis II. The buffer keeps filling.
All science data delivered to Earth.
